title: Kwenye Petronas Twin Towers, watu hufanya biashara ndogo ya kukupiga picha
label: Minara Miwili

text.It is very standard, but I came to the P: Ni sehemu ya kawaida sana ya kutembelea, lakini nilifika kwenye Petronas Twin Towers.
text.It seems these Petronas Twin Towers were: Inaonekana Petronas Twin Towers zilikuwa majengo marefu zaidi duniani hadi mwaka 2004.
text.There was something I found interesting: Kuna jambo nililoliona kuwa la kuvutia kwenye Petronas Twin Towers.
text.When you go to the bottom of the towers,: Ukifika chini ya minara, kuna wenyeji wengi sana.
text.There are many people who say they will: Watu wengi hujitolea kukupiga picha na kukuonyesha mifano wakisema, “Nikikupiga mimi, picha itakuwa nzuri hivi.”
text.I thought, \"Oh, there is that kind of s: Nilifikiri, “Aa, kumbe kuna biashara ndogo ya aina hiyo.”
text.Indeed, there were people nearby making: Kweli kulikuwa na watu karibu wakipata hela kidogo kwa kupiga picha nzuri, nami nikafikiri, “Nimeelewa.”
text.I did not have them take my photo, and I: Hata hivyo, sikuwaomba wanipige picha na niliwapuuza.
text.If you go to the bottom of the twin towe: Ukienda chini ya minara hiyo miwili, watu watakuzungumzia hivyo.
text.Under the Petronas Twin Towers, there is: Chini ya Petronas Twin Towers kuna kituo cha maduka.
text.If you go straight through that shopping: Ukipitia kituo hicho cha maduka moja kwa moja, upande mwingine kuna bustani inayoitwa KLCC.
KLCC ni kifupi cha Kuala Lumpur City Centre.
text.The KLCC park was also calm and very nic: Bustani ya KLCC pia ilikuwa tulivu na nzuri sana.
text.Honestly, when I was looking things up b: Kwa kweli, nilitafuta habari kabla ya safari yangu ya Malaysia na nikaona picha za Petronas Twin Towers tena na tena.
text.So I felt like I finally came to the pla: Kwa hiyo nilihisi hatimaye nimefika mahali nilipokiona mtandaoni, na nikapata hisia kidogo ya mafanikio.
